messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD incident id pd_2026_1768802460 — high rate of heartbeat misses from canary-inference-01 :warning:
incident-bot: automatic page to oncall @mike (primary) and @sarah (secondary) — escalation in 5m if unacked
mike: acked — looking
lee: saw the ping, grabbing logs from the canary infra, can you paste the pd id?
mike: pd_2026_1768802460 — running pdcli show pd_2026_1768802460 and tailing logs now
ops-bot: tail /var/logs/canary/inference-01.log | grep -i "missed heartbeat" --context 3
sarah: quick check — metrics show a 30s spike of 503s from synthetic probe at 2026-07-21T14:07:40Z, total customer errors = 0 :white_check_mark:
mike: logs show transient conn reset to upstream at same time, stacktrace points to transient tcp reset from host 10.2.8.44
lee: confirmed node 10.2.8.44 had a kernel network flurry — accepted connections fine afterwards. No rolling failures.
mike: running canary restart just in case: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/canary-inference -n infra-canaries` — will watch metrics for 2m
sarah: PD note: marking as no-customer-impact for now, leaving in monitoring mode. I'll add the postmortem tag 'auto-resolved-flutter' if it clears in 10m
incident-bot: pd_2026_1768802460 status: acknowledged by mike at 1768802472
ops-bot: canary probe reverted to healthy within 40s of restart; synthetic traffic shows normal RPS and latency back to baseline :tada:
mike: closing PD if no more alerts in 5m. leaving a runbook pointer: /runbooks/canaries/heartbeat-flutter.md
sarah: FYI — I triggered a brief increase in probe concurrency from the test harness at 14:07:30Z while debugging unrelated infra — might have amplified the blip. Noted in incident timeline.
lee: good call, will follow up with infra team to check host-network patching logs for 10.2.8.44
mike: closing PD now — pdcli resolve pd_2026_1768802460 — reason: transient network reset + probe concurrency bump, no customer impact.
incident-bot: pd_2026_1768802460 resolved at 1768802565 — auto-close: false
sarah: post-check: adding to weekly noise review and will consider lowering synthetic concurrency during debug windows. :memo:
mike: thanks — reassigning handoff monitor to sarah for next 10m, then back to normal oncall.
lee: ack handoff. good catch everyone.
